source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: The 2025 annual total compensation for Dr. Bourla was 277 times the annual total compensation of the median-paid employee as follows: Annual Total Compensation Albert Bourla $ 27,585,301 (1) Median-Paid Employee $99,631 (2) Ratio 277:1

notes: Employees: approximate year-end count from the FY2025 10-K. Payroll: the 10-K gives no total of salaries, benefits or personnel costs, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used. The proxy breaks it down as cash compensation (including overtime) of $95,111, no equity, a $4,473 change in pension value and $47 of other compensation, and says the median-paid employee is the same one identified for the 2025 proxy.
